page.overview:
Who is Isonash?

A nonbending native of the small, independent Jasmine Island, Isonash was a member of the state's developing anarchist movement after the Hundred Year War. From this current emerged the Autumn Leaves, a group led by Isonash who sought to completely reform Jasmine Island's system on anarchist principles.

When new elections for the island's ruling council were announced, various political factions started bitterly feuding in an attempt to gain the electorate's support. Amid this growing political crisis, White Lotus anarchist Xai Bau visited the island and secretly forged connections with islanders who were inclined to revolutionary change, including Isonash and a few others. Isonash became Xai Bau's disciple, As a result, the Autumn Leaves leader became more inclined to radical actions, concluding that he had spent too much time "playing things safe".

Isonash and most Autumn Leaves subsequently sought to undermine their homeland's political system by partaking in it, running in the elections while pushing for the dismantling of the council. Meanwhile, the protectors also aided the mission of Iroh and Piandao, White Lotus members who had come to Jasmine Island seeking Xai Bau.

Isonash was not naturally inclined to radical and quick actions, being patient and careful as he sought to avoid harming others by his actions. Having long been supportive of decentralized leadership concepts, he hoped that an anarchist system would help Jasmine Island become truly independent from outside influences which he generally deemed to be exploitative. After becoming influenced by Xai Bau, however, Isonash became much more extreme, doubting his past restraint and considering radical actions to further his cause.
